description: Maritime routes and vessel tracklet dataset for vessel-to-route association provides AIS-derived maritime routes and vessel tracklets for route-association research. The provider is Iphar, Clément; Jousselme, Anne-Laure. Geographical and temporal coverage: The original source covers Brest, France, and provides 17 extracted routes in two representations. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
